title: Repair PR #600 review 5449078494: successor-id reservation and legacy revert-form cleanup guard (captain inline)
description:
Review 5449078494 on head 27d013e2 (CHANGES REQUESTED, two blockers).
B1 (7vh3): '<id>:uncontrolled' is caller-claimable in either order (active or ended squatter), so a concentration break throws in finalizeEnd and rolls back its cause (damage/death, replacement, combat closure). Fix: reserve the ':uncontrolled' effect-id suffix as engine-owned at createActiveEffect, and refuse creating a cast-anchored-removal spell effect whose derived successor id already exists (legacy squatters). Replace the 'refuses to invent another id' test with identity-admission evidence for both orderings plus a causal break (damage-save failure) proving the damage commits and the successor is created.
B2 (ysr3): migration 0040 leaves a v39 Giant Insect link with remove/remove and no natural form; end/break/remove_effect_target would make it absent. Fix: fail closed at the cleanup seam (cleanupOwnedState + removeEffectTarget) for an actor link whose holder's 0-HP rule is 'revert-form' but whose policy is not 'revert' (no snapshot); never translate legacy remove into absence. Evidence: migrated v39 Giant Insect refused on end, break and target removal with creature/effect unchanged; Animate Objects migration stays the negative sibling.
notes: Both blockers repaired in c3b9ffc0 (pushed). verify:worktree green: 326 files, 5915 tests. Negative proofs run for both guards. Inline replies posted; awaiting fresh full review as the reviewer required.
